reviews.author: Gurpreet Singh
reviews.comment: Visitors often bring up the greenery and the relaxed, easy pace of an afternoon here — it reads more like a living room than a café counter.

reviews.author: Amanat Kaur
reviews.comment: The Biscoff Cheesecake gets singled out again and again as the dish that turns a first visit into a regular habit.
